headline: Passage Reignites as Expanse and Row Surge
war_summary: Since the 18:11 edition the wires show Callahan's Passage stirring anew after its lull, posting eight changes in two hours to 21:19 about The Crumbling Passage, Scath Passing and Crumbling Post, with holdings listed at eight Warden and two Colonial and day losses of 8,771 Colonial and 9,705 Warden. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest desk, adding nine changes in two hours and fifty-five on the day about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch to the cutoff hour, holdings now two Warden and seven Colonial, with day losses of 6,387 Colonial and 10,503 Warden. Fisherman's Row has quickened to ten changes in two hours about Eidolo, Black Well and Oceanwatch, holdings five Warden and four Colonial. Nevish Line and Stema Landing show fresh movement with two and four changes in two hours about Grief Mother, The Flair and The Wane. Palantine Berm, Mooring County and Stlican Shelf have gone quiet in the last two hours, with last reports at 18:11, 19:15 and 17:56.
